title: Kitten Snuggles With Labrador | Cat and Dog Become Best Friends
description:
If you raise a kitten with a dog they will get along just fine.  This kitten learned to trust the dog right from the first day.  The dog did not feel threatened by the little kitten because he was so little and no threat to the dog.  Now they play all of the time.  In fact, both cats grew up with my dog around and they both like to play with the dog. 

Feel free to ask my questions about raising cats and dogs together because he have had 4 cats and 2 dogs throughout time (not all at the same time) and they all got along just fine.  For more fun pet videos check out this playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLn095-hw5QHduhaXLjKspFg9dNlm824YB
